issues.title: Soft preferences below target
issues.evidence: Old heldout E5-B has 7/20 soft mismatches; TP=18, FP=9, FN=3; strict macro F1=78.33%, micro F1=75%.
issues.root_cause: Product-class duplication, omitted attributes, compatibility confusion, literal synonyms and disputed unsupported-domain labels.
issues.solution: C2-C5 prompts; contextual cleanup; independent label review. Product cleanup fixes HELD005 on replay only.
issues.tests: Offline audit, targeted Phase8.2 tests and repository regression; see verification_report.json. Live evidence only the bounded production smoke subset.

issues.title: Low complete slot accuracy
issues.evidence: E5-B full v2 slot EM=10/20; shared-field EM=12/20. Error counts overlap: soft 7, product type 2, exclusions 2, brand 1, clarification 1, active boundaries 0.
issues.root_cause: Several independently imperfect slots compound into a failed query; exact wording is a separate metric.
issues.reproduction: Inspect failure_analysis.json per-case records; compare field mismatches.
issues.solution: Improve individual slots; keep strict metric. No semantic extraction winner adopted.

issues.title: Development failure classification
issues.evidence: QU033 and QU036 both exhausted 429 retries. No successful provider JSON exists for these failures.
issues.root_cause: Legacy validity combined transport and schema failures; fallback rules overwrote QU033's provider reason.
issues.reproduction: Compare dev E5-B records with preserved raw cache; invalid_cases identifies API_429_RETRY_EXHAUSTED.
issues.solution: Stage diagnostics and failure-aware scoring implemented. JSON/schema defect allegation NOT REPRODUCED for these two cases; provider quota remains an operational risk.

issues.title: Temperature conclusion unsupported
issues.evidence: E2 used E1-B/v1, not E5-B/v2. T1 quality is higher in those stored runs; T0/T0.5 also have API failures. No independent repeated-run evidence.
issues.root_cause: Architecture transfer and quota confounding; no theorem makes T0 best for extraction.
issues.reproduction: Inspect E2 configurations and raw cache; dry-run B0,T05,T10 with repetitions=3.
issues.solution: Same-E5-B 0/0.5/1 experiment prepared; user explicitly deferred larger live work.

issues.title: Unfair exact-match comparisons
issues.evidence: Original 98% excludes preferences. Historical 54% is common-field EM. The old v1 5% vs v2 50% mixed field capabilities; missing null product_type and active boundary flags received credit.
issues.root_cause: Scoring defaults masked missing fields and failures; schema capability was confused with shared extraction quality.
issues.reproduction: Run independent scoring tests and audit; same-query shared EM is 40% vs 60%.
issues.solution: Independent versioned common/full-v2 metrics with explicit missing-field and failure policy. Old scorer retained solely for historical reproduction.
issues.tests: Offline audit, targeted Phase8.2 tests and repository regression; see verification_report.json. Live evidence only the bounded production smoke subset.

issues.title: Rules can alter intent
issues.evidence: Historical rules damage 9/18 authored oracle outputs. Conservative rules preserve all 18. This is a rule-invariance test, not LLM quality evidence.
issues.root_cause: Naive negation cues, unbound price operators, substring domain detection and global class-word blacklists.
issues.reproduction: Test not only/not necessarily/not too expensive/except Nike/no less than/not under/double negation; run rule tests and offline ablations.
issues.solution: Isolated narrow evidence rules implemented. Ambiguous and multilingual scope is still not solved; production rules not switched.
issues.tests: Offline audit, targeted Phase8.2 tests and repository regression; see verification_report.json. Live evidence only the bounded production smoke subset.

issues.title: Entity extraction versus filter activation
issues.evidence: Boeing is a named manufacturer in QU033. HELD020 treats Honda compatibility as accessory brand and omits for Honda City.
issues.root_cause: Business support policy conflates named entities with active catalog filters; a single brand slot cannot encode both.
issues.reproduction: Inspect QU033 raw output and HELD020; compare brand-preserving rule replay.
issues.solution: Preserve named manufacturers in experimental extraction; gate unsupported queries before filtering. Old labels unchanged; policy adjudication pending.
issues.tests: Offline audit, targeted Phase8.2 tests and repository regression; see verification_report.json. Live evidence only the bounded production smoke subset.

issues.title: Coverage and annotation limitations
issues.evidence: 13/15 development queries overlap original50. New 20/20/40 fixtures have 80 unique exact queries and no overlap with old fixtures.
issues.root_cause: Small handcrafted data and single-annotator policy choices; exact disjointness does not establish semantic independence.
issues.reproduction: Run fixture builder and dataset_integrity.json audit.
issues.solution: Labels authored before predictions; independent annotation and ambiguous-case adjudication still pending.
issues.tests: Offline audit, targeted Phase8.2 tests and repository regression; see verification_report.json. Live evidence only the bounded production smoke subset.

issues.title: Latency, tokens and cache provenance
issues.evidence: Old cache keys omit prompt/schema content and settings, cache errors, round temperature and reuse stored latency. Retry counts and cache flags are incomplete.
issues.root_cause: Logical cases were counted instead of actual attempts; stored metrics cannot isolate provider speed.
issues.reproduction: Run runner tests for fingerprint changes, failure caching, resume and budget exhaustion.
issues.solution: New content hashes, success-only opt-in cache, persistent attempt/token reservations and stage timings. Fresh comparative performance remains unmeasured.
issues.tests: Offline audit, targeted Phase8.2 tests and repository regression; see verification_report.json. Live evidence only the bounded production smoke subset.

issues.title: v2 to v1 semantic loss
issues.evidence: Adapter drops product_type, strict/inclusive flags and typed exclusions; negatives become soft strings and may be truncated at ten preferences.
issues.root_cause: Structural compatibility cannot preserve meanings absent in the target schema.
issues.reproduction: Read both to_v1 methods and run existing schema adapter tests; see contract review example.
issues.solution: Versioned consumer migration proposed; no breaking production schema switch made.
issues.tests: Offline audit, targeted Phase8.2 tests and repository regression; see verification_report.json. Live evidence only the bounded production smoke subset.

issues.title: Documentation contradictions
issues.evidence: Old report says seven resolved issues but enumerates eight; unsupported determinism, validity, latency and readiness guarantees remain in historical prose.
issues.root_cause: Narrative claims exceeded per-case evidence and blurred experimental versus adopted behavior.
issues.reproduction: Read synchronization addenda and compare generated figures with audit JSON.
issues.solution: Explicit superseding corrections preserve historical measurements and provide current status counts.
issues.tests: Offline audit, targeted Phase8.2 tests and repository regression; see verification_report.json. Live evidence only the bounded production smoke subset.

issues.title: Operational safety and lifecycle
issues.evidence: Settings representation/serialization and provider errors exposed sensitive values; Windows smoke teardown reproduced SSL transport warnings. Two-test retest passed after lifecycle fix.
issues.root_cause: Unrestricted exception text, double retry layers, lazy SDK sessions closed after their owning event loop.
issues.reproduction: Run reliability tests for 401/403/429/503/timeout/invalid JSON/key redaction/input bounds; inspect smoke_retest.xml.
issues.solution: Redacted settings/errors, one retry owner, exact model identity, usage-before-validation, same-loop cleanup. Injection immunity, retention policy, strict coercion and finite numeric validation remain open.
issues.tests: Offline audit, targeted Phase8.2 tests and repository regression; see verification_report.json. Live evidence only the bounded production smoke subset.
